description: Source code for translating FAPI PUSCH PDUs to internal PHY representation, including functions for filling codeword, RB allocation, UCI parameters, and conversion function.

methods.name: fill_codeword
methods.description: Fills the codeword description in the PUSCH PDU if present.

methods.name: fill_rb_allocation
methods.description: Fills the resource block allocation in the PUSCH PDU.

methods.name: fill_uci
methods.description: Fills UCI parameters in the PUSCH PDU, including handling of UCI part2.

methods.name: convert_pusch_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts an FAPI PUSCH PDU to internal PHY representation, filling various parameters and calling fill functions.
